$$
\begin{aligned}{T}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}kx \\ ky\end{bmatrix} & =\begin{bmatrix}(kx)^{2} \\ (kx)(ky)\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}{k}^{2}{x}^{2} \\ {k}^{2}xy\end{bmatrix} \\  & =k\begin{bmatrix}k{x}^{2} \\ kxy\end{bmatrix} \\  & \ne k{T}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}.\,\times \end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}{T}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}kx \\ ky\end{bmatrix} & =\begin{bmatrix}3kx \\ kx+2ky\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}k(3x) \\ k(x+2y)\end{bmatrix} \\  & =k\begin{bmatrix}3x \\ x+2y\end{bmatrix} \\  & =k{T}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}.\,✓\end{aligned}
